items.headline: Rivalry Saturday's grand finale — the Iron Bowl and 'The Game'
items.body: The best weekend in college football ends with its two loudest grudge matches, both today: Alabama hosts Auburn in the Iron Bowl at Bryant-Denny, and Ohio State meets Michigan up north in 'The Game.' Throw the records out — these are pure bragging-rights, scream-till-you're-hoarse rivalries.
items.say: It's the big rivalry day in college football — the Iron Bowl and Ohio State-Michigan, both today. Even if you don't follow it all season, those two games are always a scene. You pull for anybody?

items.headline: Derby day in England — Everton host Liverpool, Arsenal face City
items.body: It's a loaded Premier League Saturday. The Merseyside derby (Everton vs. Liverpool) brings the emotion, while the day's heavyweight bout is league-leading Arsenal hosting a wobbly Manchester City. A perfect coffee-in-hand morning watch stateside.
items.say: Big soccer Saturday in England — there's the Merseyside derby plus Arsenal and Man City. Those weekend-morning games are such an easy thing to throw on with a coffee. You ever get into the Premier League?

items.headline: The CS2 Major is live — Singapore hosts the year's big showdown
items.body: Counter-Strike's second Major of the year, PGL Major Singapore, is underway at the Singapore Indoor Stadium: 32 teams, a $1.25 million prize pool, and Swiss stages sorting out who reaches the playoffs before the December 13 grand final. The best CS2 in the world, right now.
items.say: The big Counter-Strike Major is going on right now over in Singapore — best teams in the world, huge prize pool, runs till mid-December. You play any CS, or watch the esports side of it?

items.headline: Back to Sunday football — Seahawks-49ers headline Week 12
items.body: After the Thanksgiving feast, a normal NFL Sunday returns tomorrow. The NFC West heats up with Seattle at San Francisco, Baltimore visits Houston, and Raiders-Browns got flexed into Sunday Night Football. Couch, round two.
items.say: Regular Sunday football's back tomorrow — Seahawks and Niners is the one I've got circled. You getting the games on, or all footballed-out after Thanksgiving?

items.headline: WarGames tonight — Survivor Series takes over Houston
items.body: WWE's Survivor Series: WarGames rolls into Houston tonight, built around the giant double-cage WarGames matches. The men's side pits The Bloodline against The 946, and there's a USA-vs-Mexico five-on-five loaded with Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, Rey Mysterio and Penta. Big, loud, cartoonish fun.
items.say: WWE's got Survivor Series tonight — that wild match inside the two cages. Even if you haven't watched wrestling since you were a kid, it's a fun spectacle. You ever a wrestling guy?

items.headline: Better late than never — the 100th Macy's Parade finally rolls today
items.body: After a historic storm bumped it off Thanksgiving morning for the first time in a century, the 100th Macy's Parade steps off this Saturday on NBC and Peacock. Look for Jimmy Fallon & The Roots, Megan Moroney, Teddy Swims and a big Dolly Parton tribute led by Megan Hilty — giant Snoopy and all.
items.say: The Macy's parade is actually happening this morning — they pushed it to Saturday after that storm, first time ever. Feels funny on a Saturday, but hey, giant balloons are giant balloons. You usually watch it?

items.headline: The 'Dune: Part Three' final trailer just dropped
items.body: Warner Bros. released the final trailer for 'Dune: Part Three,' Denis Villeneuve's conclusion to the Timothée Chalamet saga — a time-jumped, war-torn Arrakis with Paul fully on the throne. It hits theaters December 18, the same night as 'Avengers: Doomsday.' December's going to be a battle.
items.say: The last Dune trailer is out — the big finale hits theaters December 18, same day as the new Avengers. Going to be a wild movie weekend. You into the Dune ones, or do they lose you?

items.headline: Brace yourself — Spotify Wrapped is about to drop
items.body: It's that time of year: Spotify Wrapped is expected any day now (the usual late-November / early-December window), ready to expose exactly how many times you played that one song on repeat. Instant group-chat fodder the second it lands.
items.say: Spotify Wrapped is about to come out — the thing that tells everyone your embarrassing most-played song of the year. You nervous about yours, or do you already know what number one's going to be?

items.headline: Need a weekend binge? 'Black Doves' is back for Season 2
items.body: Keira Knightley's slick spy thriller has returned for its second season on Netflix — six new episodes of double-crosses, with Ben Whishaw back as her assassin best friend and Sarah Lancashire pulling the strings. A perfect dark-outside, long-weekend binge.
items.say: If you need something to binge this weekend, the new season of Black Doves is on Netflix — Keira Knightley as a spy, really slick and twisty. You watch the first season?
